title: Empty words remain empty under prefix extension
statement: For all natural numbers $k$ and $k'$, extending the family that assigns the empty Boolean word to every index in $\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$ to indices in $\{0,\ldots,k'-1\}$ by assigning the empty word at any additional indices yields the family that is empty at every index.
